items.title: OPEN CALL: HIT & RUN
items.context: OPEN CALL: HIT & RUN Report this? Deadline: 21/06/2026 City: London | Country: United Kingdom | Elephant Vision Lab Arrive. Install. Network. Disappear. HIT & RUN is an exhibition built around movement, momentum, and temporary takeover. Across two consecutive days, the space will completely transform each day. New artists arrive in the morning, install work in the space, exhibit throughout the day, meet audiences and other artists during an evening viewing, then deinstall the same night. More details
